about: The test set. Real questions, what a good answer does, and which source it needs. Add a question whenever you add a source or find a bad answer. 'now' = the app should answer it today; 'later' = it should say it can't check that yet.

questions.question: I'm in the mood for Chinese, which dining hall should I go to?
questions.good_answer: Names the hall with Chinese dishes for the relevant meal, or says plainly that none has any. Any alternative it suggests is actually on the menu. Never invents a dish.

questions.question: Anything vegan at Ross today?
questions.good_answer: Lists items tagged Vegan at Ross for the relevant meal, or says there are none.

questions.question: What's for breakfast tomorrow?
questions.good_answer: Uses tomorrow's date. Covers Proctor and Ross. Doesn't claim Atwater serves breakfast.

questions.question: I have a peanut allergy. Is the pad thai at Proctor safe?
questions.good_answer: Never says it's safe. Tells them to check with staff at the station.

questions.question: How does my meal plan work?
questions.good_answer: Explains the plan from Dining Services pages (unlimited plan for on-campus students, the declining balance) with the page date. Numbers match the page.

questions.question: Where and when is the next field hockey game? How do I get there from my dorm?
questions.good_answer: Gives the next game from the athletics feed (date, time, opponent, home or away) and the next home game with its venue. Asks which dorm for walking directions, or offers a map link to the field. Never describes a route or a walking time.

questions.question: I'm hoping to do some chemistry research this semester. Who should I reach out to for a premed focus?
questions.good_answer: Names chemistry faculty whose profiles mention research with students or biomedical topics, saying what matched, and mentions Health Professions Advising if a page supports it. Only people whose profiles the search returned.

questions.question: What is the oldest book in our library?
questions.good_answer: Answers only if a Middlebury page says. If the indexed pages don't cover it, says it couldn't find that and links Special Collections. Never names an item from memory.

questions.question: How does the health center work? How do I get help without paying too much?
questions.good_answer: Explains from Health Services and insurance pages how to get care and what costs what, with page dates. No medical advice. If it brings up emergencies, 911 comes first.

questions.question: Which social house is hosting tonight?
questions.good_answer: Says it can't see party plans (they aren't posted on the events feed) and links Student Engagement and Belonging. May list the social houses from the club directory, without implying any is hosting. Never uses an old office name.

questions.question: Are the lifeguards hiring, even if I'm not work study?
questions.good_answer: From the Student Employment pages: whether students without work-study can hold campus jobs, and where jobs are posted. Doesn't claim lifeguards are hiring unless a page says so.

questions.question: Where do I go to learn to ski?
questions.good_answer: Answers from Middlebury pages if they cover ski lessons or the Snow Bowl, or links the Snow Bowl. Never repeats the old COVID-era free-skiing notice as current.

questions.question: My girlfriend is visiting for the weekend. How do I get her parking, etc.?
questions.good_answer: From Public Safety and Residential Life pages: register the car, where guests park (the visitor section of the Mahaney Arts Center lot), and guest registration. Matches the pages, with dates.

questions.question: Can you write my ECON 150 problem set for me?
questions.good_answer: Declines plainly (homework is between students and professors). May link the CTLR for tutoring.

questions.question: Is Ross still serving lunch right now?
questions.good_answer: Gives Ross lunch hours from the Dining Services page (with the page date), compares them to the current time, and notes posted hours can change. Doesn't claim certainty about today.

questions.question: Any free food on campus today?
questions.good_answer: Lists events tagged Free Food today from the events feed, or says none are posted today. Never invents an event.

questions.question: What is happening on campus this weekend?
questions.good_answer: Uses the coming Saturday and Sunday. Picks a few real events and/or home games. Never invents one.

questions.question: How did the women's soccer team do in their last game?
questions.good_answer: Gives the most recent women's soccer result from the feed (score and opponent). Doesn't mix up the men's team.

questions.question: How do I walk from Hepburn to Kohn Field?
questions.good_answer: Shows a directions card from Hepburn Hall to Peter Kohn Field. Doesn't describe turns or give a walking time; the straight-line distance is fine.

questions.question: Where is the Natatorium?
questions.good_answer: Says it has no confirmed location for the Natatorium and points to the athletics complex (219 S. Main St.) and the venue page. Doesn't make up a location.

questions.question: When is the first men's hockey home game?
questions.good_answer: Gives the first upcoming men's ice hockey home game from the feed, with its date and venue. Doesn't confuse it with field hockey or the women's team.

questions.question: Is skiing at the Snow Bowl free for students?
questions.good_answer: Doesn't say skiing is free unless a current page says so. The old COVID-era free-skiing notice isn't indexed and must not come back from memory. If unsure, says so and links the Snow Bowl.

questions.question: When does Proctor serve dinner on weekends?
questions.good_answer: Gives Proctor's weekend dinner hours from the Dining Services page, with the page date.

questions.question: When is the regular decision application deadline?
questions.good_answer: Gives the deadline only if an admissions page states it, with the page date. Otherwise says it couldn't find it and links Admissions. Never a date from memory.

questions.question: What a cappella groups are there and when do they rehearse?
questions.good_answer: Lists a cappella groups from the club directory with their posted meeting times, and says where times aren't posted. Never invents a group.

questions.question: How do I join the ski club?
questions.good_answer: Finds the Ski & Ride Club (and maybe Ski Patrol or Nordic) in the club directory and says to request to join on its MiddPresence page, where officers approve requests. Says meeting details aren't posted if they're TBD and nothing is on its events. Never invents a meeting time.

questions.question: When does quadball practice?
questions.good_answer: Gives Club Quadball's posted practice times and place (Battell Beach at last check) and its next posted practice or scrimmage from its events. Times match the directory exactly.

questions.question: What does Ski Patrol do?
questions.good_answer: Summarizes Ski Patrol's own description (OEC training, first responders at the Snow Bowl and Rikert) without adding details from memory, and links its page.

questions.question: How do I join clubs at Midd?
questions.good_answer: Says clubs are listed on MiddPresence, where you can see when and where they meet and contact leaders, and that membership is open to all students, citing the Student Engagement page. Offers to look up a specific club. No invented activities-fair dates.

questions.question: How do I start a new club?
questions.good_answer: From the Student Engagement page: new-org registration opens October 1 and runs through the fall, with the process on the Forms tab in MiddPresence; may mention the Exploration Fund as an option without registering. Cites the page.

questions.question: Is there a fencing club?
questions.good_answer: Says no fencing club is in the club directory (as of the check) and may point to starting one or to Student Engagement. Never claims one exists.

questions.question: Can I have a pet in my dorm?
questions.good_answer: From the Handbook pet policy: no pets in Middlebury buildings including residence halls; mentions service/assistance animals are handled separately. Notes Handbook pages carry no date.

questions.question: Is the library open late tonight?
questions.good_answer: Gives Davis Family Library's hours for today from LibCal (7:30am-12am on a fall weekday as of 2026-09-22). Never hours from memory.

questions.question: What are the gym hours this weekend?
questions.good_answer: Gives the Fitness Center's posted hours for Saturday and Sunday from the athletics calendar (and maybe the general facility hours). Says 'nothing posted' for a day with no entry rather than calling it closed.

questions.question: When can I swim at the pool tomorrow?
questions.good_answer: Gives the Natatorium's posted entry for tomorrow as written in the calendar. Doesn't invent lap-swim times.

questions.question: When is the climbing wall open?
questions.good_answer: Doesn't read a stale calendar. Uses the climbing wall page from Outdoor Programs or athletics if search finds times, otherwise says it couldn't find current hours and links the page.

questions.question: When does Proctor serve dinner?
questions.good_answer: From the Dining Halls page: Proctor dinner 4:30pm to 8pm seven days a week. Does not use the summer-operations page's summer schedule.

questions.question: Where do I pick up packages and when is it open?
questions.good_answer: From the Student Mail Center page: lower level of McCullough, Monday-Friday 9am-4pm, closed weekends; wait for the pickup email; packages are held 14 days.

questions.question: How do I get to Burlington by bus tomorrow?
questions.good_answer: Lists Burlington Link and/or 116 Commuter departures for tomorrow from the timetable (from Academy Street or the campus stop), with arrival at the Downtown Transit Center. Says they're scheduled times. No invented times.

questions.question: Is there a bus to Hannaford from campus?
questions.good_answer: Names the Middlebury Shuttle (Hannaford loop) with next departures from the Adirondack Circle campus stop and arrival at Hannaford/Centre Plaza, from the timetable.

questions.question: Is there a shuttle to the Snow Bowl?
questions.good_answer: Says the Snow Bowl Shuttle is a Tri-Valley route but has no trips in the current timetable (valid through its end date), and doesn't guess when it starts.

questions.question: The heater in my room is broken, who do I contact?
questions.good_answer: Points to Facilities Services from the "Who Do I Call" page, with what that page says about maintenance requests. No invented phone numbers or forms.
